description: Search real-time physical retail store inventories near a shopper’s GPS location. Returns verified brick-and-mortar stores, in-stock products, unit prices, and Haversine distance in kilometers.

customer_lat.description: Shopper latitude coordinate for proximity ranking (optional)

customer_lng.description: Shopper longitude coordinate for proximity ranking (optional)

limit.description: Maximum number of matching products to return (default: 10)

query.description: Product name, category, or keyword (e.g. "coffee", "milk", "usb cable")

name: search_catalog
